page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.2xlarge is a storage-focused virtual server belonging to the ecs.d1 family and running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 physical cores operating at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 32.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB per core, and a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

A defining characteristic of this server is its massive local storage capacity, consisting of 23622 GB of HDD storage. This high-density storage profile makes it highly specialized for storage-heavy workloads, though the use of HDD technology represents a tradeoff in random I/O performance compared to SSD-based instances.

Benchmark results indicate modest computational and memory performance. The single-core and multi-core stress-ng CPU benchmarks, along with single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression, fall into the weak or poor categories. However, the passmark CPU score and large-block memory write bandwidth achieve average ratings.

Given the combination of high-capacity HDD storage and modest CPU performance, this instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for cold data storage, large-scale data archiving, and sequential-access data processing. It is less suitable for high-transaction databases or CPU-intensive applications.

This hardware profile presents a clear tradeoff: massive storage capacity at the expense of high-speed compute and random I/O performance. Consequently, this server is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring high-density sequential storage, such as data archiving, log processing, and cold storage, rather than high-performance computing or transactional databases.
